scope: admin area — apps/admin only (monorepo also contains apps/storefront)

static.method: next router config + glob apps/admin/src/app/**/page.tsx, plus api route handlers

runtime.selection_method: the three destructive endpoints, exercised against a seeded database

excluded.reason: separate application, out of the requested scope

findings.title: IDOR: order detail endpoint trusts the client-supplied id

evidence.quote: const order = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id: params.id } })
evidence.proves: the query filters by id alone, with no owner or tenant predicate

evidence.quote: GET /api/orders/9f21 as tenant A returned tenant B's order
evidence.proves: one cross-tenant read succeeded; it does not establish that every route is affected

findings.impact: any authenticated operator can read any tenant's order by guessing or enumerating an id
findings.proposed_fix: add the caller's tenant to the where clause and assert ownership server-side

findings.title: Cross-tenant leak: export endpoint ignores the tenant filter

evidence.quote: const rows = await db.invoice.findMany({ where: { createdAt: { gte: from } } })
evidence.proves: the export query constrains by date only, with no tenant predicate

findings.impact: an export run by any operator includes every tenant's invoices
findings.proposed_fix: scope the query to the caller's tenant and authorize per record set

findings.title: Duplicate mutation: refund has neither idempotency key nor server-side guard

evidence.proves: the handler calls refund with no idempotency key and no prior-refund check
the only guard is a disabled button in the client, which a retry bypasses

findings.impact: a retried or double-clicked refund charges the merchant twice
findings.proposed_fix: pass an idempotency key and reject a second refund for the same payment server-side

findings.title: Dead control: bulk archive button is routed to no handler

evidence.proves: the handler sets local state and issues no request

evidence.quote: no route matching /archive exists under the api directory
evidence.proves: no backend endpoint backs the control

findings.impact: the operator sees a spinner and believes records were archived; nothing is persisted
findings.proposed_fix: implement the archive endpoint, or remove the control until it exists

findings.title: Permission code checked in the guard but never seeded

evidence.proves: the guard requires the code reports.export
reports.export is absent from the seed, so no role can hold it

findings.impact: report export is permanently unreachable for every non-superuser
findings.proposed_fix: seed the permission code and grant it to the roles that should hold it

findings.title: External payment provider behavior under timeout is not determinable here

evidence.quote: const res = await fetch(PROVIDER_URL, { method: 'POST', body })
evidence.proves: no timeout or retry policy is set in this call; the provider's own behavior is not visible from the code

findings.impact: if the provider retries internally, a refund may apply twice — unknown without provider access
findings.blocked_by: external service — no sandbox credentials in this environment
findings.resolves_when: replay a timed-out refund against the provider sandbox and inspect whether it retries
findings.proposed_fix: pending verification; see ISSUE-003 for the idempotency key that would make it safe either way

findings.title: Filters reset when returning from detail to list

evidence.proves: filter state is component-local and absent from the URL, so it cannot survive navigation

findings.impact: an operator working a filtered queue loses their place on every return from a detail page
findings.proposed_fix: hold filter, sort, and page in the URL query string
